Suddenly, a small portion of production is in the hands of the consumers. Your kid wants an Iron Man toy? Make them one. Disney/Marvel will still make a killing producing movies, comics, and TV shows, they can still sell the stuff that you can't print, but you can now create anything. Not just toys either.

Furniture. Eating and cooking utensils. Housing. You could probably build a car if you got crafty.

Corporations would have to focus on providing the things people TRULY need. Less money would be wasted on sundry goods and consumer crap.

Production cannot remain in the hands of an elite few. We should all have access to these resources.

I'm not convinced it's "order" that is breaking down so much as nation states themselves. Things have changed so rapidly, mixed with the corruption and tyrannies they all embrace in some form, that the very notions behind "nations" aren't able to keep up. Statism is breaking down because it's a broken concept. It won't die easy though.
